title: CBDT Notifies Conditional Income Tax Exemption for Regional Air Connectivity Fund Trust (Notifications 151 & 152/2026)
content:
# CBDT Notifies Conditional Income Tax Exemption for Regional Air Connectivity Fund Trust (Notifications 151 & 152/2026)

Ek important update hai. Government ne Regional Air Connectivity Fund Trust ke liye conditional income tax exemption announce kiya hai through two recent notifications from the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT).

Here's a quick overview:

*   **Notification No. 152/2026 (Dated 23.11.2026, S.O. 6349(E)):** This notification grants conditional income tax exemption to the 'Regional Air Connectivity Fund Trust' (PAN: AADTR1130P) for four tax years, specifically 2026-27, 2027-28, 2028-29, and 2029-30. The exemption is provided under Schedule III, Table Sl. No. 36 read with Section 11 of the Income-tax Act, 2025.
*   **Scope of Exemption (152/2026):** This covers specific types of income received by the Trust, including government grants, levies collected from airlines, amounts arising from the forfeiture of bank guarantees when airlines fail to meet their obligations, and interest income earned on these three sources.
*   **Key Conditions (152/2026):** To avail this exemption, the Trust must adhere to certain conditions. It must not engage in any commercial activity, file its return of income as per Section 263(9)(c)(xiii) of the Income-tax Act, 2025, and ensure that its activities and the nature of its specified income remain unchanged throughout the exempted tax years. Non-compliance with these conditions will lead to the withdrawal of the exemption and initiation of proceedings under the Income-tax Act, 2025.
*   **Notification No. 151/2026 (Dated 23.11.2026, S.O. 6350(E)):** Alongside, Notification No. 151/2026 provides a similar exemption for the 'Regional Air Connectivity Fund Trust' for the Assessment Year 2026-27 (relevant to Financial Year 2025-26) under Section 10(46) of the Income-tax Act, 1961.
*   **Reason for 1961 Act Reference (151/2026):** This is done in pursuance of the saving provisions contained in Section 536(2) of the Income-tax Act, 2025, which preserve specified rights, obligations, liabilities, and proceedings under the repealed 1961 Act.
*   **Key Conditions (151/2026):** The exemption under this notification is also conditional. The Trust must not engage in commercial activities, maintain the unchanged nature of its activities and specified income, and file its income tax return in accordance with Section 139(4C)(g) of the Income-tax Act, 1961. Failure to comply will result in penal action and withdrawal of the exemption.
